name: com.dentalunlock/dentalunlock
title: DentalUnlock
description: Dental malpractice cost estimates, associate pay benchmarks, and job listings for US dentists.

tools.name: estimate_dental_malpractice
tools.description: Returns an estimated annual premium range for US dental malpractice (professional liability) insurance for a given state, specialty, and career stage. Relevant when a dentist or dental student asks what malpractice insurance costs, whether they are paying too much, about a renewal increase, or about occurrence vs claims-made coverage. Requires state, specialty, and graduation_year (or years_practicing); other inputs are optional and defaults are listed in the result. The result includes the estimate range (labeled as an estimate, not a quote), how new-graduate rates change over the first five years, applicable discounts, and a dentalunlock.com link with the answers prefilled. For oral surgeons, dental anesthesiologists, IV or deeper sedation, or recent claims, no dollar range is returned because those profiles are priced individually.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

specialty.description: The dentist's specialty. Use "General Dentist" for general practice.

graduation_year.description: Year the dentist graduated dental school (or will graduate this year). Provide this OR years_practicing.

years_practicing.description: Years since dental school graduation. Used only if graduation_year is not given.

weekly_hours.description: Average clinical hours per week: under_20, 20_32, or 33_plus (default 33_plus = full-time).

practice_type.description: Where they practice: private_practice (default), dso (corporate/DSO), group_practice, or other.

policy_type.description: occurrence (default — no tail bill when leaving) or claims_made.

agd_member.description: Is the dentist an Academy of General Dentistry (AGD) member? Membership can affect the estimate.

ada_member.description: Is the dentist an American Dental Association (ADA) member?

risk_management_ce.description: Has the dentist completed risk-management CE in the last 12 months?

sedation_level.description: Highest level of sedation the dentist provides. Default "None".

claims_last_5_years.description: Any malpractice claim, lawsuit, or dental-board action in the last 5 years? Default false.

tools.name: start_malpractice_quote
tools.description: Returns a dentalunlock.com link for starting a dental malpractice insurance quote request, with any known answers prefilled, and a summary of the next steps and typical timeline. Relevant when a dentist asks how to get actual malpractice quotes or wants to shop or switch their coverage. All inputs are optional. Does not submit anything; the dentist completes the request on dentalunlock.com.

tools.name: check_my_current_policy
tools.description: Returns the dentalunlock.com page where a dentist can upload their current malpractice policy's declarations page for review, and explains how the review works. Relevant when a dentist already has malpractice insurance and asks whether their premium is reasonable, mentions a renewal increase, or wants their current policy reviewed. Takes no inputs.

tools.name: start_practice_insurance_quote
tools.description: Returns a dentalunlock.com link for shopping a dental practice's office insurance: property and general liability (often a business owner's package), workers comp, cyber liability, employment practices, and employee theft (crime). Relevant when a practice owner, or a dentist buying or starting a practice, asks what office insurance they need or how to get quotes for any of these. With exactly one coverage, the link opens that policy's application directly; otherwise it opens a room-by-room walkthrough of the office that ends in a coverage checklist. For associates, explains that these policies are usually the owner's and links malpractice instead. Returns no prices, because carriers price these policies only from a full application. All inputs are optional. Does not submit anything.

coverage.description: Coverage the dentist asked about: bop (property and general liability), wc (workers comp), cyber, epli (employment practices), crime (employee theft). Omit if unsure.

role.description: owner, buying (buying or starting a practice), or associate.

team_size.description: Employees besides the dentist: solo (none), 1_3, 4_9, or 10_plus. A number is also accepted.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

tools.name: get_practice_insurance_questions
tools.description: Returns the application questions for the dental practice insurance policies a practice owner wants (property and general liability, workers comp, cyber, employment practices, employee theft), grouped by section with answer options and formats, so the owner can answer them in this chat. Use with save_practice_insurance_application to fill out the application here. A few carrier statements, the tax ID, document uploads, and the signature are done on dentalunlock.com and are listed in the result.

coverage.description: Policies to apply for: bop (property and general liability), wc (workers comp), cyber, epli (employment practices), crime (employee theft). Solo practices (no employees) skip wc, epli, and crime.

team_size.description: Employees besides the dentist: solo, 1_3, 4_9, or 10_plus.

tools.name: save_practice_insurance_application
tools.description: Saves the owner's answers to the dental practice insurance application as a draft on dentalunlock.com and returns any questions still to ask (including follow-ups opened by their answers) plus a private link where the owner confirms the carrier statements, adds the tax ID, uploads documents, and signs. Call it with the answers gathered so far, then again with application_id and resume_token to add more. It never submits or signs; nothing goes to carriers until the owner signs on the site. Needs the owner's email and the practice's state on the first call. Only call this when the owner has agreed to save their answers.

coverage.description: Policies to apply for: bop (property and general liability), wc (workers comp), cyber, epli (employment practices), crime (employee theft). Solo practices (no employees) skip wc, epli, and crime.

email.description: The owner's email. Required on the first call. Their link and prices go here.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

role.description: owner, or buying (buying or starting a practice).

team_size.description: Employees besides the dentist: solo, 1_3, 4_9, or 10_plus.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question key from get_practice_insurance_questions. Use option values for choice and yes/no questions.

application_id.description: From an earlier save, to add more answers.

resume_token.description: From an earlier save, with application_id.

tools.name: dental_salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Returns dental associate compensation benchmarks for a US state, computed from recent job listings: average and median base salary, daily rate, production percentage, signing bonuses, and how often listings include health insurance, 401(k), or paid malpractice. Figures are omitted when the sample is too small. Relevant when a dentist asks what associates are paid in a state or how pay is usually structured there.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

tools.name: search_dental_jobs
tools.description: Searches dental job listings posted in the last 6 months by state, city, and/or employer (practice or DSO name). Returns practice, location, posted compensation (salary, daily rate, production %, signing bonus), benefits, posting date, and the original listing link. Relevant when a dentist is looking for a job, relocating, or wants comparable offers.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

city.description: City name, e.g. Houston. Best combined with state.

employer.description: Practice or DSO name to match, e.g. Aspen or Heartland. Searches nationwide.

tools.name: grade_dental_contract_link
tools.description: Returns the dentalunlock.com page where a dentist can upload a dental employment contract for an A-F grade, and describes what the free grade and the optional full analysis include. Relevant when a dentist asks whether an associate contract or job offer is fair, about red flags, non-competes, or negotiating. The review itself happens on dentalunlock.com. General information, not legal advice.
